I took my poodle to the PetSmart in Canarsie location Ave D to be groomed, and the experience was absolutely awful. The groomer, Billy, did a HORRIBLE job. My dog came back with mucus still in his eyes, smelling like he hadn’t been washed properly, and the grooming itself was sloppy and not at all what I asked for.

What made it even worse was Billy’s nasty attitude. She actually told me she “never wants to deal with my dog again.” That is completely unprofessional and unacceptable. If you don’t like working with animals or treating customers with respect, you should not have this job.

Thankfully, the manager did issue me a refund, but honestly, that doesn’t fix the problem. Pet parents trust PetSmart with their animals, and people like Billy should not be working there.

⚠️ If you care about your pets, do NOT take them to Billy at this location.

I recently took my cat Waffle, to PetSmart for a bath, brush, and nail trim. I scheduled the appointment through their app, which was very convenient and easy to use. When I arrived for my 10:30 a.m. appointment, there was a short wait—about 5 to 10 minutes—but nothing too bothersome.

The staff let me know it would take around three hours, so I did some instore shopping  and came back right on time. Waffle was ready when I returned, and everything had gone smoothly. He looked clean, well-groomed, and happy! Overall, it was a positive experience, and I’ll definitely continue using their grooming services. Shout out to their Avenue D location in Brooklyn.

For the last couple years, I’ve came to this place. There has been two managers that I’ve dealt with when they were helping me adopt pets the first time it was this black woman She was short, squeaky voice, Very annoying When she was informing me about information on the pets She made assumptions I wasn’t eligible to even buy a pet even though I had everything I needed for this particular pet which I told her. It was setup for a couple of days, which was a bearded dragon. It was a birthday gift and it had to take me to go to Petco and get what I wanted. She said that my Bearded dragon will die because I don’t know how to take care of them. I get it I was a first time owner for reptiles in general and I learned quick and along the way. 9 years my 2 dragons lived for. This was all back in the span of 2012-2020. Today I went back to meet a different manager I think her name was Liz. I was adopting fishes. This new manager she looks Puerto Rican or native, glasses, grayish brown hair, she wore a grey shirt. She said that I needed to cycle my tank for about a week or so, and she had a very unpleasant attitude when I was asking her about the more information I needed to know or which fishes can I get with which. she literally expected me to know all this information before I came And to be honest, I was very afraid of asking some other questions because she was Very loud, and doubtful, this wasn’t something planned as well I just wanted a dang fish. I get that she understand everything that she is saying, but I think the sane person can tell you because she’s a manager and she may have received cases where pets ended up dying. You can’t assume that for everybody based off what they do and don’t know or doesn’t know enough of they aren’t eligible for a pet. One week and 2 days has passed. There was a coworker working in there. It was a guy. He has helped me finally and told me everything I needed to know, and I felt very comfortable asking the questions on what I needed I also studied some more on what facts I didn’t get from that lady. When I arrived home with the fishes, I adopted I let them sit in a tank for about an hour. From what I was told, the next day by that same lady “that was too much time to let them sit”. Online that LITERALLY SAYS OTHERWISE. So she tried to put it on me and blame me for a fish that died on me while the other ones were healthy, thriving moving around and my water balance/test were perfect mind you i also have a 29 gallon with live plants ACTICE algae and healthy bacteria for snails i also purchased. The tank was cycled. Again, I felt doubted today because I did everything she told me and I did my research and I still didn’t get the Fish. I got my refund but I didn’t get what I wanted so I’m giving it a one star review because the managers that works here always have a attitude and all they do is guilt trip and manipulate you. it shouldn’t be so difficult for you to follow instructions and once you did, there are now more instructions to be followed and you don’t get what you need out of it. The worst GET BETTER PEOPLE TO RUN THAT PLACE !
